court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: Distinction between claim and theory
issues.why: Court must decide whether direct and presumptive service connection are separate claims or alternative theories of one claim.

issues.label: Mootness of the appeal
issues.why: Central question is whether the PACT Act grant rendered the direct service-connection challenge moot.

issues.label: Effective date as downstream issue
issues.why: Court must determine whether effective date is a separate downstream matter requiring its own appeal or is preserved within this claim.

issues.label: Board's duty to adjudicate all theories
issues.why: Whether the Board must grant, deny, or remand every reasonably raised theory of service connection.

issues.label: Reasonably raised direct service-connection theory
issues.why: Whether the flight surgeon letter and veteran's testimony sufficiently raised a direct-service-connection theory the Board had to address.

issues.label: Potential for earlier effective date
issues.why: Whether direct service connection could yield benefits before August 10, 2022, unlike the PACT Act presumption.

issues.label: PACT Act effective-date limitation
issues.why: Whether §5110(g) and §3.114(a) bar pre-enactment benefits only for presumptive, not direct, service connection.

issues.label: Ripeness of effective-date dispute
issues.why: Whether the effective-date issue is ripe now or only after the RO assigns a date.

issues.label: Jurisdiction over unaddressed claim
issues.why: Whether the Veterans Court and Board had jurisdiction/obligation over the unadjudicated direct claim.

issues.label: Standard of review
issues.why: Court must apply appropriate standard to legal questions of mootness and duty to adjudicate.

issues.label: Prejudice to the veteran
issues.why: Whether failure to adjudicate the direct theory prejudiced Hepler by risking loss of earlier effective date.

issues.label: Board's referral to RO adequacy
issues.why: Whether the Board's instruction to the RO to consider direct-basis evidence satisfied its adjudicative duty.

issues.label: Precedential effect on other cases
issues.why: Judge Bartley noted the decision is routinely cited, implicating systemic impact warranting review.

issues.label: Availability of separate future appeal
issues.why: Whether requiring a separate appeal adequately protects the veteran's rights or improperly defers resolution.

issues.label: Continuity of pending claim through PACT Act
issues.why: Whether the pre-existing 2011 claim survives independently of the intervening PACT Act grant.

issues.label: Pro-claimant construction of veterans statutes
issues.why: Whether interpretive canons favoring veterans affect the mootness and duty-to-adjudicate analysis.

issues.label: Capable of repetition yet evading review
issues.why: Whether any mootness exception applies given recurring reliance on the ruling.
